insight: Sells security as composable API services (AI Guard, Prompt Guard, audit log, redaction, authz), so you add guardrails with plain API calls.
name: Pangea
tagline: API-based security guardrails for AI apps: prompt injection, PII redaction, and access control.
description: Pangea provides composable, API-first security services for AI applications. AI Guard and Prompt Guard defend against prompt injection, sensitive-data disclosure, and malicious content, alongside AI access control and visibility products. Pay-as-you-go with a free monthly balance, integrable via LiteLLM and Portkey.

modelSupport.notes: Guardrail services sit in front of any LLM; provider-independent.
